citation: HL7 v2.3 Chapter 8, section 8.3.1 MFN/MFK - master files notification, p 8-4. Structure ID MFK_M01 synthesised as CODE_EVT from the message code MFK and M01, the first event overrides.json eventsFromTitle gives it (v2.3 prints no structure ID and no Table 0354). Events MFK^M01, MFK^M03, MFK^M08, MFK^M09, MFK^M10 and MFK^M11 from overrides.json eventsFromTitle (section 8.3.1 'MFN/MFK - master files notification' names no event): HL7 v2.3 Chapter 8, section 8.3.1 MFN/MFK - master files notification, p 8-4: the general master file application acknowledgment (v2.3 prints the message code alone and no structure ID; the section title names no event; 8.3, p 8-3, 'MFK, master files application acknowledgment'); Table 0003 (Chapter 2, section 2.24.1.9, pp 2-90 to 2-94), p 2-92, lists M01 to M11 as MFN/MFK: it takes M01 and the events whose master file sections print no MFK of their own (M03 and M08 to M11, section 8.7.2 'MFN/MFR - test/observation master file', p 8-21); 8.6.1, 8.8.1, 8.9.1 and 8.10.1 print their own MFK..
